quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #15
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: When changing lanes, what should you do?

options.text: Use only your rearview mirror.
Look over your shoulder toward the direction you want to move.
Use only your left side mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look over your shoulder toward the direction you want to move.
questions.explanation: Look over your shoulder to check your blind spot before changing lanes. Check multiple times if needed. Watch traffic ahead and in the lane next to you.

questions.question: When should you use your horn?

options.text: When another vehicle is in your way.
When it may help prevent a collision.
When another driver makes a mistake.

questions.correctAnswerText: When it may help prevent a collision.
questions.explanation: Use your horn only when necessary to prevent a crash. Do not use it to tell slow drivers to speed up or move out of your way.

questions.question: When poor weather or light requires you to turn on your lights, which should you use?

options.text: Parking lights.
High beams.
Low beams.

questions.correctAnswerText: Low beams.
questions.explanation: Use low beams in fog, snow, or rain. High beam light reflects back and creates glare, making it harder to see.

questions.question: Which statement about drugs and driving is true?

options.text: Any prescription drug is safe if you do not feel drowsy.
Over-the-counter drugs can impair your driving.
Only illegal drugs can impair your driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Over-the-counter drugs can impair your driving.
questions.explanation: Prescription and over-the-counter drugs can impair driving. This includes drugs for colds, allergies, and anxiety. It is illegal to drive while impaired by any drug—whether illegal, prescription, or over-the-counter.

questions.question: At an intersection with a yield sign, what must you do?

options.text: Yield to cross traffic that is close enough to cause a crash.
Yield only to vehicles on your right.
Slow down but never stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to cross traffic that is close enough to cause a crash.
questions.explanation: At a yield sign, give the right-of-way to traffic already in the lanes you want to enter or cross. Be ready to stop. You may continue without stopping if no traffic is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign show?

options.text: The distance from the road to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height for vehicles in this state.
The maximum width for vehicles on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from the road to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This is a low clearance warning sign. It shows how much space is between the road and the bottom of a bridge or overpass (in this case, 12 feet 6 inches).

questions.question: When changing lanes, what should you do?

options.text: Check your side mirror and look over your shoulder to confirm the lane is clear.
Check your rearview mirror only.
Slow down.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check your side mirror and look over your shoulder to confirm the lane is clear.
questions.explanation: Before changing lanes, check your side mirrors and look over your shoulder to make sure it is safe.

questions.question: What is the correct way to make a right turn?

options.text: Signal, slow down, and move to the lane closest to the center line before turning.
Signal, slow down, and move to the lane closest to the right curb before turning.
Approach from the right lane, but move toward the center of the street before turning.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal, slow down, and move to the lane closest to the right curb before turning.
questions.explanation: Before turning right, signal and slow down. Approach from the right lane and stay as close as possible to the right curb or road edge.

questions.question: When you see a flashing yellow light at an intersection, what must you do?

options.text: Stop completely at the intersection.
Keep going at normal speed.
Slow down and proceed with caution.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and be alert. Proceed carefully through the intersection.

questions.question: What must you do at an intersection with a flashing yellow light?

options.text: Wait for a green light before proceeding.
Slow down and cross the intersection carefully.
Stop before crossing the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and cross the intersection carefully.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down, stay alert, and proceed carefully. Watch for crossing traffic and pedestrians.

questions.question: To avoid losing traction on wet roads, you should:

options.text: Make sudden turns.
Brake hard.
Slow down.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down.
questions.explanation: To prevent hydroplaning, drive slower on wet roads and keep your tires in good condition. If you lose control, take your foot off the gas. Do not brake. Keep the vehicle straight and let it slow down naturally.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: No passing zone.
Slow-moving vehicle.
Two-way traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: No passing zone.
questions.explanation: A yellow triangle sign with black words means no passing zone. You will see it on the left side of two-lane roads where you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: If a tire suddenly blows out while driving, you should:

options.text: Hold the steering wheel firmly, slow down, and move out of traffic.
Pump the brakes quickly.
Brake hard and steer toward the right edge of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hold the steering wheel firmly, slow down, and move out of traffic.
questions.explanation: If your tire blows out, stay calm. Hold the steering wheel firmly and take your foot off the gas to let the vehicle slow down. Apply the brakes gently when safe. Do not move to the shoulder until your speed is much lower.

questions.question: Hydroplaning happens when tires ride on water instead of the road. To prevent it in wet weather, you should:

options.text: Use cruise control to keep a steady speed.
Slow down.
Move to the shoulder as soon as it rains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down.
questions.explanation: Hydroplaning happens when you drive too fast on wet roads. Slow down when the pavement is wet to prevent hydroplaning.

questions.question: When driving in work zones, you should:

options.text: Speed up to get through quickly.
Slow down and be ready to stop suddenly.
Drive at your normal speed through the zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop suddenly.
questions.explanation: Slow down when entering a work zone and be prepared to stop. Follow all posted speed limits and watch for workers who may be present.

questions.question: When you see a flashing red traffic light, you must:

options.text: Stop completely, let oncoming traffic and pedestrians pass, then go.
Slow down and go carefully.
Stop and stay stopped until the light turns green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, let oncoming traffic and pedestrians pass, then go.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light works like a stop sign. Stop completely, let other traffic and pedestrians pass, then go when it is safe.

questions.question: The first thing alcohol affects is:

options.text: Vision.
Judgment.
Balance.

questions.correctAnswerText: Judgment.
questions.explanation: Alcohol reduces all the abilities you need to drive safely. It enters your blood and affects the part of your brain that controls judgment and skill.

questions.question: Which of these is a safe driving technique?

options.text: Using high beam lights in fog.
Looking straight ahead at the road.
Checking your rearview mirrors often.

questions.correctAnswerText: Checking your rearview mirrors often.
questions.explanation: Check your rearview mirrors every 2 to 5 seconds to stay alert. Only looking straight ahead is dangerous. In fog, use low beam headlights, not high beams.

questions.question: When turning right, you should not:

options.text: Signal to other drivers.
Turn too wide into another lane.
Slow down.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn too wide into another lane.
questions.explanation: When turning right, slow down and use your turn signal. Do not turn too wide, as this can interfere with other traffic.

questions.question: Your vehicle's wheels run off the edge of the road. What should you do first?

options.text: Turn the steering wheel slightly left to get back on the road.
Hold the steering wheel firmly, release the gas, and brake gently.
Brake hard and turn the steering wheel sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hold the steering wheel firmly, release the gas, and brake gently.
questions.explanation: Hold the steering wheel firmly, take your foot off the gas, and brake gently. Wait until you slow down, check traffic, and find a safe place to return to the road. Do not jerk the wheel hard, as this can make you lose control or go into other lanes.

questions.question: When another vehicle is passing you:

options.text: Brake hard.
Keep the same speed.
Speed up.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep the same speed.
questions.explanation: Keep driving at the same speed when another vehicle passes you. Do not speed up. Let the other vehicle safely move back into your lane.

questions.question: When driving in fog, rain, or snow, use:

options.text: Low beams.
High beams.
Fog lights only.

questions.correctAnswerText: Low beams.
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in fog, rain, and snow. High beams reflect off wet weather and create glare. This makes it harder to see the road ahead.

questions.question: When you see a flashing yellow light at an intersection:

options.text: Stop before crossing.
Slow down and look both ways, then go.
Wait for a green light before going.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and look both ways, then go.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light tells you to slow down and check for traffic from other directions. Look both ways and then proceed carefully.

questions.question: When passing another vehicle:

options.text: Pass slowly.
Drive at the same speed as the other vehicle.
Pass quickly and safely.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pass quickly and safely.
questions.explanation: Pass the other vehicle as quickly and safely as possible. Move back to your lane only when you can see both of the other vehicle's headlights in your mirror.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Do not enter.
No parking.
No U-turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: No U-turn.
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction at this location.
